ads_config.description: Controls Google Mobile Ads. Includes global/format kill-switches (banners, interstitials, app open, rewarded), cooldown timers in seconds, and active AdMob unit IDs for live and test environments.

app_config.description: App support and essential gameplay parameters: maintenance mode, hint timer delay, daily challenge unlock & reward, and review prompt timing.

announcement_config.description: Controls broadcast announcement cards shown on the Home screen. Set active to true/false, and customize title and message text for real-time user notices.
